properties.site-address: Land at Deben High School, Garrison Lane, Felixstowe
properties.notes: Submitted as part of the Council's Call for Sites (Site 941) but not taken forward as a Preferred Site in Suffolk Coastal Local Plan. Included in Brownfield Land Register as found to be suitable, available and achievable through the Suffolk Coastal Strategic Housing and Economic Land Availability Assessment - part PDL/part greenfield, dwelling estimates relate to PDL based on 30 dwellings per hectare.
